description: Mash 2.3 'mash dist': MinHash (bottom-s) sketches of the reference and query files (canonical k-mers, MurmurHash3, the sketch of Ondov et al. 2016: KmerAnalyzer.CreateMinHashSketch) and, for every query in order and every reference, the line 'reference TAB query TAB distance TAB p-value TAB shared/total' of the pairs whose p-value is at most maxPValue (-v) and distance at most maxDistance (-d); table = true (-t) writes the '#query' header and a row of distances per query (a pair that fails a filter leaves its field blank); individual = true (-i) sketches every sequence on its own, named by its id (sequences shorter than k are skipped). A file without a record of at least k symbols is refused as the program refuses it (exit status 1: 'All fasta records in input files were shorter than the k-mer size'). Numbers are printed as C++ cout does (6 significant digits). VERIFICATION: 220 / 220 random sets (1 - 4 references x 1 - 3 queries of 1 - 3 records, k 4 - 32, sketch size 5 - 2000, seeds, -n, -i, -t, -v, -d) equal the installed mash 2.3 byte for byte.

references.description: The reference files as FASTA texts (records start with '>': the first word of the header is the sequence id, the rest the comment).

referenceNames.description: Names of the reference files as the program prints them (default reference1, ...).

queryNames.description: Names of the query files (default query1, ...).

individual.description: -i: sketch individual sequences instead of whole files.

reads.description: -r: the inputs are read sets (noise filter -m, target coverage -c, genome size -g); incompatible with individual.

minCopies.description: -m: minimum copies of each k-mer required to pass the noise filter of a read set (default 1; only with reads).

targetCoverage.description: -c: target coverage of a read set: sketching concludes when it is reached (default 0 = read everything; only with reads).

genomeSize.description: -g: genome size used as the sketch length of a read set (default 0 = estimated; only with reads).

showComments.description: -C: show the comment fields with the names (name:comment for dist, the comment instead of the id for triangle; the comment of a file sketch is the first record's name and comment, '[N seqs] ... [...]' for several).
